test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Heat Engine) Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: When selecting a sheet size for an original drawing, what should be the primary consideration?

options.text: The orientation of the drawing (horizontal or vertical).
The standard size of the drawing office.

solution:
The correct answer is __The clarity and resolution required****.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The clarity and resolution required__ should be prioritized when selecting a sheet size for an original drawing.
 
• This ensures that the details of the drawing are accurately represented and easily understood.
 
• Choosing the correct sheet size helps in maintaining proportionality and improves the presentation of the design.
 
• Other factors like orientation and reproduction size are secondary to clarity and resolution.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Orientation of the drawing:**
 
 
• Whether the drawing is horizontal or vertical can affect the selection but is not the primary consideration.
 
 
 
• **Size of the reproduction:**
 
 
• The reproduction size influences the choice but must align with the clarity required for the original drawing.
 
 
 
• **Standard size of the drawing office:**
 
 
• While convenient, the standard size is secondary to ensuring the drawing's clarity and readability.
 
 
</ul
